name: Cultist: Shadow Pennant heals mark the healed Cultist with Void-Touched (#11428)
contract: Shadow Pennant 706926 and its rank 2 525307: the Cultist's auto attack damage heals the lowest health ally
affected by his Black Blood 804153 with the direct heal 500773. With the Void-Touched passive 300286, that
direct heal applies one Void-Touched 301982 stack to the healed ally, as every direct heal from the Cultist does.
A Cultist alone with his own Black Blood is that ally, so his auto attacks heal and mark him even at full health.

steps.label: CONTROL: the Cultist carries his own Black Blood
